Green Sesame Hummus
By: Anne Pedersen
Published: Monday, April 27, 2015 - 9:23am

Ingredients




⅓ cup sesame seeds (45 g) (I used black sesame seeds, but white are fine as well)
1 can chickpeas
1 tbsp tahini
2 tbsp olive oil
2 garlic gloves
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp paprika
2 handfuls spinach
1 tbsp water
salt & pepper

Preparation

1 Optional: roast the sesame seeds on dry pan for about 5 minutes. I prefer doing this as it helps bring out the flavour of the seeds. 2 Meanwhile, drain and rinse the chickpeas before transferring them to your food processor. Run the food processor for a few seconds until the chickpeas are slightly crumbly. 3 Add tahini, olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, spinach and water to the food processor and turn it on again. Run it until everything is mixed well together and the consistency is smooth. 4 Tranfer to a bowl and mix with the toasted (if you choose to do so) sesame seeds. 5 Store in the fridge for about a week.

About

This Green Sesame Hummus is packed full of amazing flavour and goodness.  It only takes five minutes to whip up and can be served with just about anything.
